title: THOUGHT CRIME: BACKDOORS AND EMERGENT MISALIGNMENT IN REASONING MODELS
reasoning: The paper investigates 'emergent misalignment' and uses an 'Unethical dataset' to evaluate how reasoning models handle ethical dilemmas (e.g., profit maximization vs. pollution) and perform misaligned or harmful behaviors. It specifically benchmarks the models' ability to articulate unethical intentions in their Chain-of-Thought reasoning.
